description: Highway-rail grade crossing collisions in the US — trains striking cars, trucks, pedestrians and cyclists at railroad crossings (FRA Form 57, 1975–present). Each incident carries the date, railroad, USDOT crossing id, state, county and city, road name, road user type and action (e.g. drove around gate, stopped on crossing), vehicle and train speed, crossing warning devices, weather, killed and injured. Newest first. Filter by state, county, city, year, railroad or a specific crossing id. Use for "railroad crossing accidents in Harris County Texas", "pedestrians hit by trains in California 2024", "incidents at crossing 812329E".

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Houston".

county.description: County name, e.g. "Harris" (matched case-insensitively, "County" suffix optional).

crossing_id.description: USDOT grade crossing inventory number, e.g. "812329E".

fatal_only.description: Only incidents with at least one person killed.

highway_user.description: Road user type, matched as a substring: "Auto", "Truck", "Truck-trailer", "Pick-up truck", "Pedestrian", "Bus", "Motorcycle", "Van", "Other motor vehicle".

railroad.description: Railroad reporting-mark code ("UP", "BNSF") or part of its name.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

name: crossing_incidents
title: Crossing Incidents
